Dialogs.Dialog: Um... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about kissing and stuff？
No, um, you know. Just wondering what I'd do if you didn't like it much...
Or so I thought... But lately, not so much？
Touching you makes me feel safe, somehow. ...Just kidding.
▲高嶺＊＊▲... I'm glad. Then from now on I'll confidently do more...
Geez, you get carried away so fast. Nope.
Um... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about kissing and stuff？
I was wondering what I'd do if you actually didn't like it...
I don't mind kissing you？ No, actually, I want more...
...Sorry. I didn't quite catch that, so once more.
That face... You heard me, didn't you？
(If she makes that face, of course I want to tease her.)
Um... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about kissing and stuff？
As long as it's only me, it's okay. Whatever you do.
Wanting to touch the person I love... you... I feel that too.
...I can be a little conceited about that much, right？
Um... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about kissing and stuff？
No reason. I was just curious.
Hmm... So you'd ask something like that for no reason.
So asking about it for no reason or treating it lightly isn't good, I think...
...... I have nothing more to say.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Um... When you kiss someone first, are you nervous after all...？
!? W-Well... I guess I'm not NOT nervous？
I see... Then what about the very first time？
My heart was pounding, in lots of ways... Anyway, what's up, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Some assignment？
Yes... This is my first time, so I don't know what to do...
Um... Does that mean ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is going to kiss me？
Wait, seriously？ From ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ To me？
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
▲主人公＊▲. ...Do you know how many kinds of kisses there are？
Pfft!! Wh-What's gotten into you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Not weird, exactly, more like it made my heart jump...
I just thought knowing about it might come in handy when the time comes...
N-No！ If anything, bring it on！
...I'm glad. Not right away, but wait for me, okay？
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hmm... Got it！ You want me to kiss you！
Wait, I got it right!? Yes！ Then as a reward, right here...
(I'll have to be careful next time...)
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？
"Life is infinitely stranger than anything which the mind of man could invent."
It's a line from Sherlock Holmes.
You have to swap "life" for "love," but it's really like that.
It's so strange, full of mysteries I can't solve... I only know one thing.
...Yeah. Maybe if I know just that, the mysteries don't need solving？
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？
Hmm... One-sided or mutual, it's all love, right？ Even when it hurts... Even when it's fun, even when it's happy.
And still you want to be together, so it must have amazing power.
I get plenty from ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What about ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...Yes, now I'm all set too. Thank you.
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？
If I'd never fallen in love, maybe I'd never have known ugly feelings like jealousy...
...That's what I think sometimes. To be honest.
But in return... No, even more than that, you've taught me wonderful things. That's why I can't let go.
This is all new to me, so I'm always unsure right now.
Take responsibility for making me like this, okay？ ...Just kidding.
Well, um, I thought it might help.
I dream of an ending where the prince comes for me, I guess？
...I do know that's impossible in real life, okay？
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？ Solved the mystery？
Well... Love is complicated and hard, and sometimes I want to throw it all away...
But somehow, when I see you, that feeling just vanishes.
I still don't think I can solve why that happens, but...
I feel it when I see you. The warmth, how dear you are... I've figured out that's enough？ ...Just kidding.
Oh no, I'm saying something huge.
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？
Hmm... I've realized people are... No, I'm greedy.
Yes. You give me so much power, and it's never enough.
Love is scary. I feel like I'm getting uglier and uglier...
...I see. But I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that too.
Not at all. Here, take as much as you want！
Thank you... I'm glad I fell in love with you.
So, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what do you think about love？
Yes. I've started to think overthinking isn't good... I think？
Yes. It's my first time, so worrying and being unsure must be natural.
...As long as I have the unshakable goal of loving you, maybe that's enough？
But reassure me sometimes？ Just holding my hand is enough. ...Just kidding.
Because I'm your girlfriend. I trust you.
...Does that mean you're going to do something to make me jealous？
Ah, no！ That's not what I meant！
(Argh, why do I keep making myself look suspicious！)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, do you think you're the jealous type？
I wonder... Want to test it？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, do you think you're the jealous type？
Because I'd hate it if you got close with another girl.
Manaka Takane will get jealous with all her might！ ...Just kidding.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s all-out jealousy... Kind of curious...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, do you think you're the jealous type？
I wonder？ I don't think so.
I see... You've never been jealous before？
No. People have been jealous of me, but me being jealous...
Why is that, I wonder？ There's no point being jealous of a plain girl like me. Do you know why？
(I think ▲高嶺＊＊▲ should think a little more of herself...)
That look！ Are you doubting me again!?
...If you want me jealous that badly, fine？
I'll hide you away somewhere where no one can ever see you.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, do you think you're the jealous type？
Right. You almost cry just imagining it.
Geez, don't bring that up. ...Do you not like girls who get jealous？
...Don't you dare get close to other girls.
(Maybe having her get jealous once in a while is fine...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, do you think you're the jealous type？
You asked me before... Yes, nothing's changed？
Having a wonderful boyfriend is hard on a girlfriend. Just kidding.
But I'm not popular, you know？ Except with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez, you get carried away so easily. Hehe▼
What do you think about skinship？
I... might not like it much.
Not all of it？ Just, how do I put it... the kind where I can feel some intent...
What do you think about skinship？
I don't dislike it... but sometimes it startles me a little. Because it's sudden.
O-Oh, right. Of course, sorry. Then from now on...
But it'd also be awkward if you announced it first and then touched me all over.
Ah, sorry. Were you about to say something？
What do you think about skinship？
Ugh... Did you maybe hate it？
No, not that. But just a little bit of TPO...
TPO... Time, place... What was the last one？
"Opportunity"... no, that's a Mars rover... Hmm？ Oh, "occasion"！
Ah, right！ Hehe, that feels better.
(Yeah, feels great！ ...Huh？ What were we talking about？)
What do you think about skinship？ Between guys and girls, I mean.
If you're going out, I think some is to be expected？
Holding hands, putting an arm around a shoulder...
Skinship is originally something parents and kids need, and it's natural there... right？
What do you think about skinship？
I like it more than before... I think？ It's not bad.
Is that something to be so happy about？
Of course！ It means my skinship skills are recognized！
Geez, you get carried away so fast.
But yes... I've come to feel that touching is important.
Don't get too eager, okay？ I'm just a tiny bit bad with the mood at times like that.
What do you think about skinship？
It's just a feeling, but I think our timing's starting to match.
Yes. When I think I want to hold hands, you take my hand.
It makes me feel our hearts are connected, and I'm happy... Just kidding.
Geez, don't stare like that. It's embarrassing.
What do you think about skinship？
We talked about this before, right？ Hmm...
Yeah. I just wanted to ask again.
I think you're thinking about TPO properly.
Hehe, top marks▼ But that doesn't mean you can get carried away. No-no！ Okay？
